missions.open_mission_en: Increase economically deliverable electricity produced from solar radiation at the Earth's surface, subject to constraints on annual net delivery, lifecycle cost, reliability, materials, manufacturability, deployment speed and scalability.
missions.open_mission_zh: 增加由地表太阳辐射产生的可经济交付电力，同时约束年净交付电量、生命周期成本、寿命与可靠性、材料可得性、可制造性、部署速度与规模化。
unknowns_public: Whether new mission-relevant evidence or a qualified Verification World can change the verifiable envelope

missions.current_blocker: No binding active Open Mission Control authority and no valid Strategy selection; LG-A exited current Local Game scope after fail-closed requalification.
missions.disclosure_note: PUBLIC SUMMARY. Exact Local Game representations, Search traces and proprietary evaluation details are intentionally withheld.
missions.next_reality_gate: Human authority must bind active Open Mission Control and complete a valid Strategy selection before any Local Game requalification or Search request.
missions.open_mission_en: Discover under equivalent or explicitly comparable service, safety and equipment constraints underused battery states, trajectory structures, controllable degrees of freedom or production functions that enable the same physical battery asset to deliver more lifetime useful service.
missions.open_mission_zh: 在相同或明确可比较的现实服务、安全和设备约束下，发现当前尚未被充分利用的 battery state、trajectory structure、controllable degree of freedom 或 production function，使同一物理 battery asset 能够交付更多 lifetime useful service。

missions.open_mission_en: Discover and ultimately validate one or more controllable interventions capable of safely driving an aged adult organism through a durable, system-wide state transition from an aged functional state toward the integrated functional and homeostatic state of a healthy young adult.
missions.open_mission_zh: 发现并最终验证一种或多种现实可控的作用方式，使已经衰老的成年生物体发生安全、全身性、跨系统、可持续的状态转移，从衰老功能态恢复到接近健康年轻成年人的整体功能与稳态水平。
